text:
noah: Quick sync: I want to route a tiny fraction of real traffic to the new low-latency tier but keep strict rollback safety. Thoughts?
anya: do the staged shadow first (5%), telemetry gate (p95 + error rate), and keep quota reservoir lower. also add an emergency ttl flag.
noah: example config snippet: `{route: "message-gen", priority: "fast-path", sample: 0.05, fallback: "previous"}`
felix: console dry-run is simulation only. use /api/v1/configs/dryrun?enable_shadow=true to forward copies. tag with metadata owner=noah.
noah: can ops-bot auto-revert if error-budget burns quickly?
devops-bot: rule `auto_revert_on_budget` exists; must opt in on rollout: `auto_revert=true`. it will revert to last-stable and ping #release-war-room.
anya: also add `reservoir_pct:80` and `reservoir_step:+5%/12h` so we ramp safely.
felix: add observability_links in rollout; SRE can add a delta tile for p95/5xx/token-burn.
noah: plan: staging shadow 5% for 2h, then 20% for 6h with telemetry gate enabled. starting dryrun now.
devops-bot: Canary started for config message-gen-v2 (job 202312-442). shadow=0.05. notifications: #eng-platform, #sre.
noah: smoke checks: p95 +0.4%, 5xx unchanged. advancing to 20%.
anya: remember to run cost-simulate and note finance.
noah: noted. will post final status later.
